title: How Wolves Change Rivers [REMASTERED HD] - George Monbiot
summary: A short narrated video describing how reintroducing wolves to Yellowstone triggered a trophic cascade that changed wildlife, vegetation and even river courses. This is a remastered HD version of George Monbiot's viral piece.
why: HN cites it as a compelling example of unforeseen ecosystem effects and rewilding.

quote.text: probably one of the most fascinating videos on YouTube
